edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: New birth and living hope replace the older begotten/unto register without losing the birth image. Ordinary you address and judges restored. In 1:13 fully now qualifies set your hope rather than sober, while gird up the loins of your mind remains. Pure in 1:22 is restored from the consulted NA28 wording. The imperishable inheritance/seed, fire-tested faith, lamb/blood and grass/flower images remain; quoted human address in 1:16 uses you.

chapters.decision: Ordinary address and modern verbs restored, with a smoother living-stones clause and conduct clause. The stone/head-of-corner images, royal priesthood, holy nation, possession, darkness/light, household slaves and crooked masters remain. Awareness of God smooths 2:19 without changing the conscience/awareness relation. In 2:24 tree and singular wound are retained; sins remains plural. The four short commands in 2:17 remain distinct.

chapters.decision: The weaker-vessel image and fellow-heir dignity remain together; women replaces the awkward substantival female, with the weaker-vessel image still explicit. Sarah calls Abraham lord, with no divine-address archaism introduced. Christ as Lord in 3:15 follows the consulted wording. Christ suffered once for sins to bring you to God (3:18) remains, as do flesh/spirit, spirits in prison, Noah, eight souls and baptism saves you. Also is included in 3:21.

chapters.decision: Modern third-person verbs restored. The vice list retains its distinct items, and the flood image remains in flood of reckless living. Prayers remains plural in 4:7. Words from God renders logia naturally in 4:11. In this matter at 4:16 follows the consulted NA28 merei rather than inherited in this name. The proclamation even to the dead (4:6), fiery ordeal, Christian, judgment beginning at God’s house, and faithful Creator remain.

chapters.decision: The initial therefore in 5:1 is removed because it is absent from the consulted NA28 running text. Shepherding, oversight, willingly according to God, the flock and all paired contrasts remain. Humility as clothing, mighty hand, casting anxiety and the roaring lion are preserved. The four future verbs in 5:10 remain distinct. Forever in 5:11 represents the shorter to the ages formula, distinguished from ages of ages in 4:11. Silvanus, Babylon, Mark, kiss of love and the final peace greeting remain; no final Amen is added.
